description: This file defines the SsmClient class in the AWS SDK for PHP, which provides methods to interact with the AWS Systems Manager (SSM) service. It includes method annotations for various API operations such as creating, deleting, describing, and updating SSM resources and sessions.

classes.name: Aws\Ssm\SsmClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the AWS SSM service, extending AwsClient to include SSM-specific API methods.

methods.name: addTagsToResource
methods.description: Adds tags to a specified resource in SSM.

methods.name: associateOpsItemRelatedItem
methods.description: Associates an OpsItem with a related item.

methods.name: createActivation
methods.description: Creates an activation for managed instances.

methods.name: createAssociation
methods.description: Creates an association between a document and managed instances.

methods.name: createDocument
methods.description: Creates a new Systems Manager document.

methods.name: describeInstances
methods.description: Describes the details of managed instances.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Retrieves one or more parameters from the Parameter Store.

methods.name: listDocuments
methods.description: Returns a list of all Systems Manager documents.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Executes commands on one or more managed instances.
